name: Soren
description: A delicate fusion of creamy warmth and toasted sweetness. Soren unfolds with effortless elegance, leaving a soft, addictive trail that lingers long after you've left.

tabs.scent: Creamy, warm, and softly sweet — Soren is built around a single unmistakable accord rather than a long list of competing notes. It is designed to be worn close, noticed slowly, and remembered anyway.
tabs.bottle: Each 50ml bottle is filled and finished by hand at our Ilorin atelier, in small batches. No two production runs are rushed to meet a calendar — we bottle when the batch is ready.
tabs.delivery: Reach us on WhatsApp or email to place an order — we'll confirm availability and arrange delivery or a pickup at the atelier directly with you.
